Who is Pablo Birger?

Pablo Birger (January 7, 1924 - March 9, 1966) was an Argentinean driver, who competed in his home Grand Prix twice, both times in a , and retiring both times.

Birger was killed in a traffic accident in his home city of Buenos Aires.
